messages:
maria: FYI customer (tenant: tid_9843) hit 403s on embeddings right after they upgraded from free->team. UI shows 'Invalid API key'. They insist the key works for other endpoints. Can someone triage?
jordan: pinging logs now, any specific request ids?
maria: one sample rId: r_0a7b2c, timestamp ~2026-03-15T14:02Z
alex: quick check — that rId returns 403 body: `{ \"error\": \"invalid_api_key\", \"code\": 403 }`. headers show x-entitlement-version: 42 and x-plan: team
eng-oncall: could be entitlement cache lag after the plan upgrade. We saw a similar pattern last quarter where plan sync didn't invalidate the front cache, resulting in gateway returning 403s with misleading code.
billing-bot: plan change event processed for tid_9843 at 2026-03-15T13:58Z, but downstream sync worker queued (job id: job_7721) and showed retry/backoff until 14:05Z
jordan: that aligns — customer upgraded at ~13:57Z and then started calls at 14:00Z. gateway likely saw stale entitlement state.
maria: customer repro steps: they ran `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_***" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings` and got 403. They also tried list-models and it succeeded with same key.
alex: interesting — list-models uses public route, embeddings hits entitlement check code path. If entitlement cache returns old plan=free, gateway returns 403 with 'invalid_api_key' as a masked message. Poor UX.
eng-oncall: can we force a sync/invalidate for tid_9843 and then ask them to retry?
jordan: running cache invalidation now: `POST /internal/entitlement/invalidate {"tenant":"tid_9843"}` -> success job 9092 queued.
eng-oncall: also kicked the plan sync worker for that job id, logs show success at 14:07:12Z, new entitlement version 45 applied to cache.
maria: relayed to customer, asked them to retry in 30s.
maria: customer tried again at 14:08Z — embeddings request succeeded (200) and tokens billed. They confirmed in thread: "works now, thanks" :party_parrot: 
alex: root cause: plan-change -> delayed downstream sync -> cache returned stale entitlement -> gateway masked as invalid key. Filed followup issue to improve message mapping and surface `entitlement_mismatch` instead of generic invalid key.
jordan: created ticket INF-4523 for hardening: ensure gateway checks entitlement-version header freshness and return clearer error codes + metric to alert on plan-change error spikes.
maria: customer updated support ticket to close. Marking this Slack thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
